verdict.rationale: Claude's Research feature is documented as agentically running multiple searches that build on each other, and it delivers answers "complete with easy-to-check citations." That covers the core of grounded, cited answers. One community user reports it works well for research; another prefers competitors' research depth, which is a quality opinion rather than a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the searches cover the live, current web; details on how citations link back to source URLs; independent hands-on corroboration of citation accuracy.
